title: Complete the Quality, Responsibility, and Readiness Review

blocks.title: Review the finished version of the same project
blocks.text: Use READY Quality Review: Relevant, Evidenced, Accountable, Designed, and Yours. Keep it distinct from READY Automation Screen. AI may identify gaps; it does not assign a certification decision.

SUPPLIED FICTIONAL TRAINING CASE: The reviewed intake tabletop from Lesson 6.2 has retained tests for complete input, a missing delivery date, and absent human approval. Its polished presentation claims readiness for any business, but gives no usable test references, names no review/correction route, uses color-only status marks, and says AI created the entire result. No live deployment, customer result, measured saving, actual organizational permission, or certification decision is established.
